entities.summary: Bruce Raymond Gradkowski is an American former professional football quarterback and coach who currently serves as the assistant wide receivers coach for the Detroit Lions of the National Football League (NFL). He previously served as the offensive coordinator for the St. Louis BattleHawks of the United Football League (UFL). He played college football for the Toledo Rockets.
